definitions.explanation: A dish of bonito fillet seared briefly over a fire so that the outside is cooked and the inside stays raw, then sliced thick and eaten with garlic, ginger, green onion and a citrus soy dressing. The best-known local dish of Kōchi (old Tosa).

examples.japanese: カツオのたたき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{高知|こうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧カツオのたたき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: When I go to Kōchi, I want to eat seared bonito.

examples.japanese: ⟦わら→わら：27567_wara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧カツオのたたき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、ニンニク⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Bonito tataki seared over burning straw is fragrant and delicious eaten with garlic.

notes:
たたき (from ⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧, to pat) refers to patting the seasonings into the seared fish. Kōchi's version is famously seared over burning straw ({藁焼|わらや}き).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カツオのたたき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make seared bonito
- {藁焼|わらや}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カツオのたたき: straw-seared bonito
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧たたき: tataki eaten with salt instead of the soy dressing

WRITING: also ⟦{鰹|かつお}→鰹：06106_katsuo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たたき or ⟦{鰹|かつお}→鰹：06106_katsuo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叩|たた}き.
